- Septoria (CDDM_1928): circular grayish-brown lesions, close but lighter centers
- Early_Blight: single large lesion with concentric rings — no match
- Late_Blight: large blighted patches — no match
- TSWV: mosaic ring patterns — no match

The visual pattern in the test image (discrete dark spots on a green flat leaf) best matches the Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato reference.
